integrity.probabilities: Exact rational enumeration of all 60 ordered top-three sequences.

scientific_limitations: The claim concerns only five items with worths (1,34,37,1,1) and top-three Plackett–Luce successive sampling.
It establishes a pairwise covariance sign counterexample only; it gives no general characterization for other worth vectors or sample sizes.
title: A finite counterexample to negative association in successive weighted sampling
